root.label: Renee Good family files two civil lawsuits against federal government

events.label: Renee Good family files two civil lawsuits against federal government

slots.name: unnamed agents
slots.sentence: The lawsuit also lists 10 federal agents who were also present at the scene as John Does, noting that the federal government has not released their identities and that they were wearing masks at the time of the killing.

slots.name: immigration agent deaths
slots.sentence: DHS has provided little public indication that it is investigating Good's death or the death of Alex Pretti at the hands of Border Patrol agents a few weeks later in Minneapolis.

slots.name: children
slots.sentence: The lawsuits describe Good as a poet and mother of three children, and that she and her wife, Becca Good, dropped their 6-year-old son off at school before stopping her car in the middle of Portland Avenue after seeing patrolling ICE agents.

slots.name: Renee Good age
slots.sentence: the 37-year-old killed last January by a federal agent during the Trump administration's immigration enforcement surge in Minnesota

slots.name: deaths in encounters
slots.sentence: At least 10 people have died in encounters with immigration officers during President Donald Trump's second term.

slots.name: gunshot wound paths
slots.sentence: This complaint cited the Hennepin County medical examiner who ruled Good’s death as a homicide following a private autopsy and the office finding “three clear gunshot wound paths” to her body.

slots.name: deaths by immigration agents
slots.sentence: According to The Trace, a news site that focuses on gun violence, nine people have been killed by immigration agents since President Trump took office again last year.
